output.subject: mcp dependency floor raised to >=1.19.0 to fix silent CallToolResult loss
output.action_text: Upgrade `mcp` to `>=1.19.0` (now enforced by `claude-agent-sdk-python` 0.1.70). Older `mcp` versions mishandled `CallToolResult` from in-process SDK MCP tool handlers, sending the model a validation-error blob instead of the real tool output — silent failure mode.
